categories.main_business_segments: Gogolook operates primarily in two segments: digital anti-fraud services and fintech. Its digital anti-fraud offerings include the consumer app Whoscall and enterprise solutions under the ScamAdviser brand. The fintech segment includes the Roo.Cash financial product recommendation platform and the JUJI microloan app. The company also provides trust cloud services and commercial services related to digital identity and fraud prevention.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI and big data analytics based on the world's largest communication and digital fraud databases, covering phone numbers, URLs, and cryptocurrency wallet addresses. It develops proprietary risk identification technologies integrated into SaaS cloud services, enabling real-time fraud detection across multiple digital channels. Continuous R&D focuses on AI-driven fraud prediction, identity verification, and multi-dimensional risk assessment in communications, finance, e-commerce, and Web3 environments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gogolook serves individual consumers through its mobile apps and subscription services, and enterprises including banks, telecom operators, payment providers, and e-commerce platforms. Its markets span Taiwan, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and expanding into Europe and the Americas. Key end markets include digital advertising, financial services, telecommunications, and government agencies focused on fraud prevention and digital trust.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and is expanding into the Philippines, Malaysia, Europe, and the United States. It maintains offices in Taipei and Hong Kong and has subsidiaries in Thailand, Japan, the Netherlands, and other locations to support global operations and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gogolook operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital trust and fraud prevention supply chain. It develops proprietary software and AI services delivered via cloud platforms to end consumers and enterprise clients. It relies on upstream cloud infrastructure providers like AWS and Google Cloud for hosting but controls the core technology and data analytics layers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation in fraud detection and digital identity verification, expanding from call and SMS fraud to personal cybersecurity and enterprise anti-scam solutions. It invests heavily in R&D (over 10% of revenue) to develop new features such as personal data leak detection, automatic scam website alerts, and image-based scam message recognition. Strategic initiatives include international market expansion, integration of acquired domain risk technologies, and building a digital financial ecosystem with enhanced AI risk control.
categories.revenue_model: Gogolook generates revenue through a mix of digital advertising, subscription fees for premium app features, enterprise SaaS licensing for anti-fraud solutions, and fintech platform commissions. Consumer apps offer free basic services with paid advanced features. Enterprise clients pay for API/SDK integrations and managed anti-scam services. The fintech segment earns via financial product referrals and lending platform fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Whoscall leads caller identification and anti-fraud apps in Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Japan, and South Korea, competing with apps like TrueCaller, CallApp, and Phone by Google. In enterprise anti-fraud, competitors include Japan's Tobila Systems and North American firms Hiya and First Orion. Roo.Cash competes with platforms like Money101 in Taiwan. Gogolook differentiates through its extensive multi-country data, AI capabilities, and integrated communication and digital identity fraud prevention.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gogolook achieved revenues of approximately NT$870 million, representing a 12% year-over-year growth and doubling since its innovation board listing. The company maintains a high gross margin (~91%) but reported a net loss due to increased R&D and market expansion expenses. It employs over 200 staff with a growing R&D team and invests more than 10% of revenue annually in research. The company is expanding its global footprint and expects continued revenue growth with improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gogolook emphasizes building digital trust through advanced AI-powered fraud detection and prevention across multiple communication channels and financial services. Its unique value lies in leveraging the largest global communication fraud database combined with proprietary AI algorithms to provide real-time, multi-dimensional risk identification. The integration of consumer and enterprise solutions, plus a growing fintech ecosystem, differentiates it as a comprehensive trust technology leader enabling safer digital interactions and financial inclusion.
